name: academic-professional-portal-template
description: Professional reusable academic portal template with sample data, consolidated design system, human-friendly admin and automated quality checks.

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/routerize.mjs && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.cjs -i assets/css/tailwind-input.css -o dist/assets/css/tailwind.css --minify && node scripts/professionalize.mjs && node scripts/scroll-polish.mjs && node scripts/ui-refinement.mjs && node scripts/showcase.mjs && node scripts/theme-system.mjs && node scripts/v3-consolidate.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run audit
scripts.test: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:visual
